interviewExperiences.source: Glassdoor — ThreatLocker Interview Questions & Answers (2026) — https://www.glassdoor.ie/Interview/ThreatLocker-Interview-Questions-E4588562.htm (public snippets; full page bot-walls bare curl, verified via text fetch)
interviewExperiences.role: IT / technical roles: Jr Cyber Hero, Application Technician, general technical
interviewExperiences.summary: 31 interviews reported; 45.2% positive experience; average difficulty 2.45/5 (Easy). Hiring events are a major channel (on-the-spot interviews common). Application channels: 57% online, 26% recruiter, 9% in person. Average process length 18 days. IT-role interviews skew practical (hands-on VM/homelab questions) plus behavioral/customer-service questions.
questionsReported: Could I build a virtual machine (Jr Cyber Hero, hiring event)
Why did you choose to work for ThreatLocker?
Why do you want to work for us?
Why did you choose cyber security?
Tell me about yourself and goals.
What do you know about endpoint security? (Application Technician)
How do you address problems in the workplace, and how were they resolved?
How do you respond to a frustrated or angry customer?
[After describing a homelab] What is the most technically difficult problem you have run into setting up such environments?

interviewExperiences.source: Glassdoor — ThreatLocker Reviews overview — https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/ThreatLocker-Reviews-E4588562.htm (public snippets; verified via text fetch)
interviewExperiences.summary: 3.3/5 overall from ~176 reviews; 58% would recommend; CEO Danny Jenkins 67% approve; 59% positive business outlook. In-office culture emphasized ("no remote work at all"); fast-paced, high-expectation environment; leadership praised in positive reviews; work-life balance rated 3.0/5. Useful framing for interview questions about culture fit and pace.
